projects.title: Cognify: Focus & Study
projects.featureNote: Local-first Flutter study app with OCR, ONNX, and cross-device sync
projects.subtitle: Cross-platform Flutter study app with offline-first storage, AI-assisted card generation, semantic answer evaluation, and optional Google Drive synchronization.
bullets: Organizes subjects, study sets, and cards with flashcard, multiple-choice, and answer-practice review modes.
Generates draft cards from notes, documents, PDFs, images, and camera captures through a local-first extraction pipeline.
Extracts text using Android ML Kit and Windows PP-OCRv6/PaddleOCR providers.
Evaluates written answers locally using a bundled MiniLM ONNX model with rule-based fallback.
Stores working data in local SQLite and optionally synchronizes account-scoped profiles through Google Drive.
Integrates native Android Kotlin and Windows C++/WinRT bridges for OCR, speech, authentication, media, and Store services.

projects.title: RightSpeak
projects.featureNote: Local neural TTS with Piper / ONNX
projects.subtitle: Windows reading utility with cross-application text retrieval, global hotkeys, local System.Speech and Piper voices, and continuous long-form playback.
bullets: Reads typed text, selected text, and supported documents through global hotkeys, tray actions, and the main window.
Retrieves external content through Windows UI Automation, focused-control inspection, and clipboard fallback with preservation and restoration.
Handles browser and PDF content through retry, stabilization, fallback, and candidate-scoring strategies.
Synthesizes speech locally through Windows System.Speech or Piper ONNX voices with continuous chunked playback.
Manages Piper voice discovery, catalog filtering, download, verification, update, cancellation, and removal.
Integrates single-instance activation, configurable hotkeys, Microsoft Store entitlement and updates, and focused xUnit gating tests.

projects.title: AudioScript
projects.featureNote: Local AI transcription, live audio capture, and speaker diarization
projects.subtitle: Privacy-focused Windows desktop application for offline transcription, live audio capture, speaker diarization, transcript editing, and local session management.
bullets: Runs fully local transcription through bundled whisper.cpp models, with optional larger models managed on demand.
Captures microphone audio, Windows system playback, or a mixed source for live transcription using NAudio and WASAPI.
Processes long recordings and live audio through silence-aware chunking, parallel transcription workers, and timed-result merging.
Performs offline speaker diarization with pyannote Community-1, including cancellation and checkpoint/resume support.
Provides transcript editing, autosave, session recovery, speaker relabeling, and per-row re-transcription.
Exports transcripts to .docx and captured audio to .mp3.

projects.title: LocalCam
projects.featureNote: Multi-protocol LAN camera discovery and RTSP streaming
projects.subtitle: Windows desktop application for discovering compatible local-network cameras and managing concurrent RTSP playback, snapshots, and recordings.
bullets: Discovers compatible cameras through ONVIF, SSDP/UPnP, mDNS, UDP, ARP-assisted probing, and bounded subnet scanning.
Displays concurrent RTSP streams through LibVLCSharp with per-camera and dashboard-wide playback controls.
Captures snapshots and records streams to local .ts files with automatic 60-minute segment rollover.
Persists RTSP configuration, discovery preferences, window placement, and configurable media folders.
Produces structured JSONL diagnostics for discovery, playback, recording, settings, entitlement, and update operations.
Integrates packaged Microsoft Store entitlement, Premium purchasing, application updates, and x64 MSIX distribution.

projects.title: MemoCards
projects.featureNote: AI card generation, OCR, spaced repetition, and secure per-user data
projects.subtitle: Private Next.js study application with spaced repetition, AI-assisted card generation, OCR capture, server-generated audio, and Supabase-backed user isolation.
bullets: Secures private per-user decks, cards, sessions, and audio through Supabase Auth, PostgreSQL RLS, and user-scoped Storage.
Runs review, learn, and cram sessions with an SM-2-style spaced-repetition engine, progress history, and study streaks.
Generates reviewable card drafts from lesson text using Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite through Google Vertex AI.
Extracts text from uploaded or captured images through Google Cloud Vision with crop, rotation, and scan-enhancement tools.
Generates card audio through Google Cloud Text-to-Speech using a durable PostgreSQL queue with retries and stale-job recovery.
Supports keyboard-first entry, paste-many validation, local drafts, folders, tags, search, and JSON/CSV import and export.

projects.title: Product Costing
projects.featureNote: Collaborative costing, nested BOMs, RLS, and audit history
projects.subtitle: Responsive operations workspace for product costing, purchasing, nested bills of materials, account collaboration, and auditable business data.
bullets: Secures cloud data through Google OAuth, Supabase Auth, PostgreSQL RLS, and owner/editor/viewer workspace permissions.
Calculates material, labor, waste, overhead, markup, tax, unit cost, profit, and margin using a cents-based costing engine.
Supports reusable parts, nested bills of materials, subassembly rollups, and circular-reference detection.
Derives weighted-average material costs from purchase history through PostgreSQL functions and triggers.
Provides responsive desktop, tablet, and mobile editors with debounced saves, validation, and draft-row handling.
Includes JSON/TSV import and export, trigger-based audit history, searchable activity, and focused Vitest coverage.

projects.title: GEDAC Company Website
projects.subtitle: Corporate website conceived, designed, and developed end-to-end for GEDAC Electric Company to present products, services, and company capabilities.
bullets: Conceived, designed, and delivered GEDAC Electric Company's official public-facing website.
Built interactive website behavior using jQuery and vanilla JavaScript.
Created custom page layouts and styling with vanilla CSS.
Deployed and maintained the production site on ASP.NET Framework.
Solely designed and developed the website end-to-end, from backend and frontend implementation to hands-on server deployment and network infrastructure configuration.
